description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerServiceMock for the IWebAudioPlayerService interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server media service. It includes mock method declarations for controlling and querying a web audio player.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayerService for testing purposes.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks creation of a web audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks destruction of a web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks starting playback of the web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks pausing the web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks setting end-of-stream for the web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieving available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieving buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieving device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks setting the volume of the web audio player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume of the web audio player.
